# Rekody

> Free voice dictation for macOS. Hold Option Space and speak; the text lands at your cursor in any app about 100ms after you release. Transcription runs on-device by default: no account, no analytics, no audio stored. The Mac app is free; the CLI is open source (MIT).

Key facts, all verifiable in the linked repositories:

- The default engine is Rekody Streaming (English), built on NVIDIA Nemotron: words appear as you talk, with roughly 60ms of flush after release. A local Whisper engine (five sizes) and cloud engines (Groq, Deepgram) are options.
- Everything runs locally by default. The app makes zero analytics calls. Optional AI cleanup can run locally through Ollama.
- A personal dictionary corrects your names and jargon deterministically, snippets expand spoken triggers, and every dictation can build a private, local fine-tuning dataset.
- Free Mac app download: https://github.com/rekody/rekody-app/releases/latest/download/Rekody.dmg
- CLI install: brew install rekody/rekody/rekody

## Pages

- [Home](https://rekody.com/): what Rekody does, how it works, download.
- [Use cases](https://rekody.com/use-cases): dictation in email, chat, documents, and code editors.
- [Open source](https://rekody.com/open-source): what is MIT (the CLI) and what is free but closed (the Mac app).
- [Privacy](https://rekody.com/privacy): the on-device model, what the site collects (cookie-less page counts only), what the app never collects.
- [Support](https://rekody.com/support): help and contact. Email support@rekody.com.
